testcase.name: Scenario: Hide and restore a panel while its unpinned expansion is open: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:532:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide and restore a panel while its unpinned expansion is open ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top ✔ And the Modify panel is visible with its additional command area open and unpinned ✔ When the user opens the ribbon panel selector ✔ Then the selector and the Modify additional commands are visible together ✔ When the user clears Modify in the panel selector ✔ Then Modify is unchecked and its main panel and additional commands are hidden ✔ And a small Modify title strip with a pin remains visible beneath the ribbon ✔ And the panel selector remains open ✔ When the user selects Modify in the panel selector ✔ Then Modify is checked and its main panel and additional commands are visible again ✔ And the panel selector remains open
